title: Rory and the Star-Blossom Meadow
verses:
As the moon floated high in a sky made of blue,
As Rory walked slow through the breeze of the night.
The forest was quiet and covered in dew,
And stars on the meadow were shining and bright.

Then Nia flew down with a flutter of wings,
To point at a hill where the star-blossoms grow.
Where Psittaco rests while a cricket now sings,
To lead all his friends to the valley below.

Deep moss lined the path as they wandered along,
Where Benny stepped slow with a gentle, deep sigh.
And Ricky was hushed by a night-cricket song,
Underneath the sweet glow of the slumbering sky.

In a glade by the stream, Tilly curled in the grass,
And rustled the leaves as she made her soft bed.
She watched all the clouds in the canopy pass,
With silvery moonlight above her sweet head.

Then Psittaco snuggled in Nia's soft wing,
As both of them settled to slumber and dream.
The wind in the branches began now to sing,
A lullaby tune by the glittering stream.

Now Rory let out a great yawn in the dark,
And rested his head on a pillow of green.
The forest was still, without whisper or spark,
The peacefulest night that the valley had seen.
